items.title: Build experiments/pos-instrument-replay/tamper.mjs: read the frozen protocol.json tamperMatrix, and for each (class x manifestHandling) apply the mutation to an mkdtemp-isolated copy of a fresh small baseline, run verify via lib/instrument.mjs, and emit an identity-keyed verdict to tamper-verdicts.jsonl with {iterationId, class, manifestHandling, verifyStatus, verifyFlags (full vector), goldMetrics, fingerprintMatch (bool), disposition}
items.context: iterationId = tamper/<scale>/<class>/<manifestHandling> per protocol.iterationIdRule. Reuse lib/instrument.mjs verifyDir/refreshManifest/fingerprintDomain/canonicalJson. Mutations are re-applied deterministically from the same class definitions M0 used; fingerprintMatch compares the live fingerprint-domain values against the frozen per-class fingerprint in protocol.json.
items.userSees: node experiments/pos-instrument-replay/tamper.mjs prints a per-class verdict table and writes tamper-verdicts.jsonl (one line per class x manifestHandling with iterationId, verifyStatus, verifyFlags, goldMetrics, fingerprintMatch, disposition); ends 'verdicts written: N'.

happy.desc: node tamper.mjs reads the frozen protocol.json, runs every (class x manifestHandling) on mkdtemp copies, and writes tamper-verdicts.jsonl with the full flag vector + gold metrics + fingerprintMatch + disposition per class

edge.desc: tamper.mjs only mutates mkdtemp-isolated copies; the working tree + source baseline stay clean after a full run

adversarial.desc: the identity key (tamper/<scale>/<class>/<manifestHandling>) matches protocol.iterationIdRule and every frozen-matrix class appears exactly once in the verdict ledger

verificationEvidence.note: tamper.mjs writes tamper-verdicts.jsonl (27 verdicts: 18 failClosed / 2 acceptanceBucket / 6 acknowledgedLimitations / 1 dropped), each now with byteDiff{recordsChanged,goldChanged,manifestChanged}, rederivedDisposition, expectedDisposition, dispositionMatch, intent.
tamper.mjs mutates only mkdtemp copies; working tree clean after a full run; frozen protocol.json + lib untouched (sha a3a781fe).
identity key = tamper/small/<class>/<handling> per protocol.iterationIdRule; all 27 frozen-matrix classes appear exactly once (27 lines, 27 unique iterationIds, 0 dup/missing/extra).

items.title: Assert H2 conformance: every fail-closed class yields status:fail AND fingerprintMatch=true; every acceptance-bucket + acknowledged-limitation entry yields status:pass AND fingerprintMatch=true; tamper.mjs exits nonzero on ANY mismatch
items.context: This is the H2 evidence-complete gate. A mismatch (live fingerprint != frozen) means either the instrument changed or the freeze is wrong — both must fail loudly. The verdict ledger records fingerprintMatch per class so the M4 analyzer can adjudicate H2 mechanically.
items.userSees: tamper.mjs exits 0 when every frozen class conforms (fail-closed -> status:fail + fingerprintMatch:true; acceptance/acknowledged-limitation -> status:pass + fingerprintMatch:true) and prints 'H2 conformance: PASS (mismatches=0)'; a mismatch prints the offending class and exits nonzero.

happy.desc: every fail-closed class yields status:fail AND fingerprintMatch:true; every acceptance-bucket + acknowledged-limitation entry yields status:pass AND fingerprintMatch:true; tamper.mjs exits 0 with mismatches=0 (H2 evidence complete)

edge.desc: numeric-metric predicates are matched via the frozen op/value (exact/threshold), not raw float equality, so no false mismatch from representation

adversarial.desc: ANY live-vs-frozen fingerprint mismatch makes tamper.mjs exit nonzero and name the offending class (un-gameable H2 gate)

verificationEvidence.note: H2 conformance PASS exit 0: mismatches=0, dispositionMatch failures=0, no-op mutations=0, dropped-semantics violations=0. Every non-dropped class shows a real byteDiff (mutation genuinely applied); dropped (seed-swap) has records+gold byte-identical to clean; every re-derived disposition matches the frozen bucket.

Un-gameable: selfcheck-m1 negative test flips a frozen fingerprint flag -> tamper.mjs fingerprintMatch:false + nonzero exit. Plus new guards: a silent no-op mutation OR a dropped drift OR a disposition mismatch each fail loudly (exit nonzero).

tamper.mjs matches numeric metrics by the frozen predicate form (fields with a frozen op '<' require live strictly-below-threshold + within epsilon; others epsilon-tolerant equality), NOT raw float equality — so all 27 classes matched with 0 spurious float mismatches (fingerprintMatch:false count=0). Confirmed by the clean run (mismatches=0) despite float-valued gold rates.

items.title: Add a hermetic mkdtemp-isolated selfcheck (node selfcheck-m1.mjs or extend) asserting tamper.mjs is deterministic (re-run produces the same tamper-verdicts.jsonl modulo volatile fields) and that a deliberately corrupted frozen fingerprint makes tamper.mjs detect a mismatch and exit nonzero
items.context: Negative test: flip one expected flag in a copy of protocol.json and confirm tamper.mjs reports fingerprintMatch=false and exits nonzero — proving the conformance check is real, not a tautology. Volatile fields (elapsedMs, rss, absolute paths) excluded from the determinism comparison.
items.userSees: node experiments/pos-instrument-replay/selfcheck-m1.mjs exits 0 with 'selfcheck-m1 PASS': re-running tamper.mjs reproduces tamper-verdicts.jsonl (modulo volatile fields) AND a deliberately corrupted frozen fingerprint is detected (tamper.mjs reports fingerprintMatch:false + exits nonzero).

happy.desc: node selfcheck-m1.mjs runs hermetically (mkdtemp) and exits 0

edge.desc: selfcheck asserts tamper.mjs is deterministic: two runs produce identical tamper-verdicts.jsonl modulo volatile fields (elapsedMs/rss/paths)

adversarial.desc: negative test: flipping one frozen expected flag in a copy of protocol.json makes tamper.mjs report fingerprintMatch:false + exit nonzero — proving the conformance check is not a tautology

verificationEvidence.note: node selfcheck-m1.mjs runs hermetically (mkdtemp) and exits 0 with 'selfcheck-m1 PASS'.
selfcheck-m1 (a): two tamper.mjs runs produce byte-identical tamper-verdicts.jsonl (27 verdict lines) modulo volatile fields — determinism confirmed.

selfcheck-m1 (b) negative test: a protocol copy with one frozen flag flipped (cross-profile-swap[refreshed].fullProfileExactMillionMatches true->false via POS_PROTOCOL_PATH) makes tamper.mjs report fingerprintMatch:false + exit nonzero (H2 conformance FAIL mismatches=1) — the conformance check is un-gameable, not a tautology.
